title: On embeddings of the difference graph of the intersection power graph and the power graph
summary: The power graph of a finite group $G$ is a simple undirected graph with vertex set $G$ and two vertices are adjacent if one is a power of the other. The intersection power graph of a finite group $G$ is a simple undirected graph with vertex set $G$ and two vertices $x$, $y$ are adjacent if $\langle x\rangle \cap \langle y \rangle \neq \{e\}$. The difference graph $\mathcal{D}(G)$ of a finite group $G$ is the difference of the intersection power graph and power graph with all isolated vertices removed.
